kpis.explanation: Nombre de nouveaux contrats long terme signes chaque annee par Linde pour construire, detenir et exploiter des installations de production de gaz industriels (azote, oxygene) directement chez ses clients.
kpis.signal: Linde a signé 59 nouveaux contrats on-site en 2024 (record pour la 5e année consécutive), représentant 64 futures installations chez des clients, contre 53 en 2023.
kpis._source: Communiques de presse Linde (linde.com/news-and-media) : FY2021 - 'Linde ... achieved another record year for small on-site contracts, signing 43 new projects during 2021' (publie 2022-01-27) ; FY2022 - 'Linde signed 52 new small on-site projects for the supply of nitrogen and oxygen, a 21% increase compared with 2021' (publie 2023-02-03) ; FY2023 - 'Linde signed 53 new small on-site projects with capex totaling $270 million for the supply of nitrogen and oxygen during 2023' (publie 2024-01-23) ; FY2024 - 'During 2024, the company signed 59 new long-term agreements for which it will build, own and operate 64 plants at customer sites' (publie 2025-02-04).
